parts.text: The cultivation of a hobby and new forms of interest is therefore a policy of the first importance to a public man. cultivation 耕作；培养；教养 cultivate v.(衍生出)培养 policy n.(处事) 原则，策略；做法 importance n.重要，重要性；傲慢；名望 But this is not a business that c an be undertaken in a day or swiftly improvised by a mere command of the will . swiftly improvised 迅速地即兴创造/仓促地应付 The growth of alternative mental interests is a long process. alternative adj. different from the one you have and can be used instead 其他的，另外的 The seeds must be carefully chosen ; they must fall on good ground; they must be sedulously tended , if the vivifying fruits are to be at hand when needed . at hand 触手可得;近在手边
The cultivation of organic vegetables requires a lot of patience and specific knowledge. 有机蔬菜的耕作需要大量的耐心和专业知识。
Historian Paul Lovejoy relates that the cultivation of kola nuts in West Africa is hundreds of years old.历史学家保罗·洛夫乔伊提到，在西非，可乐果已有数百年的种植历史。
The cultivation of crops has expanded into progressively drier regions as population densities have grown. 随着人口密度的增长，农作物的种植已经扩展到了越来越干旱的地区。

headers: cultivate v.耕作；培养（关系/素质）
cultivate vegetables / peonies 种植蔬菜/牡丹
cultivate v. develop / build up 培养；建立
rows: Most of the world’s fertile land is already cultivated. She has worked hard to cultivate a positive relationship with her new neighbors. 她一直努力与新邻居培养良好的关系。
Modern farmers use advanced irrigation systems to cultivate vegetables in the greenhouse. 现代农民利用先进的灌溉系统在温室里种植蔬菜。
It takes many years to cultivate a deep understanding of traditional Chinese medicine. 建立对中医的深度理解需要很多年的时间。

parts.text: Harmonious relationships are what many companies aim to cultivate. 许多公司都致力于培养和谐的关系。
We must cultivate compassion for ourselves, for others and for our survival. 我们必须为了自己，他人及我们的生存去培养怜悯之心。
The word "culture" comes from the Latin "colere", which literally means "to cultivate". “文化”这个词来自拉丁语“colere”，字面意思是“培养”。
We encourage the cultivation of a hobby and new forms of interest to prevent professional burnout.我们鼓励培养爱好和新形式的兴趣，以防止职业倦怠。

headers: cultivate hobbies 培养兴趣爱好
cultivate a love of art 培养对艺术的热爱
cultivate good study habits 养成良好的学习习惯
rows: Parents should encourage their children to cultivate hobbies like music or painting. 父母应该鼓励孩子培养像音乐或绘画这样的兴趣爱好。
Regular visits to museums can help students cultivate a love of art. 经常参观博物馆可以帮助学生培养对艺术的热爱。
Teachers work hard to help students cultivate good study habits early in life. 教师们努力帮助学生在生命早期养成良好的学习习惯。

parts.text: Honesty is the best policy.
We are not about to change our editorial policy. 我们不打算改变我们的社论方针。
This is a mission of importance.
The discovery of this document is of great historical importance. 这一文件的发现具有重大的历史重要性。
This is a matter of the utmost importance. 这是个极其重要的问题。

headers: of the first importance 头等重要
of leading / primary / paramount importance 首要的/最重要的
of vital / crucial importance 至关重要的
of secondary importance 次要的
of equal importance 同等重要
rows: When designing a bridge, safety is of the first importance. 在设计大桥时，安全是头等大事。
Protecting the environment is of paramount importance to the future of our planet. 保护环境对我们星球的未来至关重要。
Timely medical intervention is of vital importance in treating heart attacks. 在治疗心脏病发作时，及时的医疗干预至关重要。
For some people, salary is of secondary importance compared to job satisfaction. 对某些人来说，与工作满意度相比，薪水是次要的。
In a balanced diet, proteins and vitamins are of equal importance. 在均衡饮食中，蛋白质和维生素同等重要。

parts.text: The value of any financial asset can change swiftly. 任何金融资产的价值都会迅速发生变化。
However, some actors can improvise. 而且有的演员还会即兴发挥。
The unexpected presentation had to be swiftly improvised due to a last-minute change in the agenda.由于议程的临时变动，这份意料之外的演示不得不迅速地即兴创造。
Have you any alternative suggestions?
After retiring, he developed alternative mental interests, such as learning philosophy and painting. 退休后，他培养了其他的精神寄托，比如学习哲学和绘画。
For retired professionals, the growth of alternative mental interests is key to maintaining cognitive health.对于退休专业人士来说，替代性心智兴趣的成长是保持认知健康的关键。

headers: alternative to sth. …的替代方案/选择
have no alternative but to do… 别无选择，只好……
alternate adj. 轮流的，交替的
rows: Is there a viable alternative to surgery? Solar power provides a clean alternative to fossil fuels for energy production. 太阳能为能源生产提供了一种替代化石燃料的清洁方案。
I have no alternative but to report him to the police. Since the last bus had already left, we had no alternative but to take a taxi home. 由于末班车已经开了，我们别无选择，只好打车回家。
I visit him on alternate Sundays. The team consists of alternate layers of experienced professionals and enthusiastic trainees. 该团队由资深专业人士和热情的实习生交替组成。

parts.text: I always keep a dictionary close at hand. 随时可用
The signature must be given by hand. 用手
The work is in hand, and will soon be completed. 正在进行中
They are always on hand whenever you need them. 有空，有时间
I can’t remember his phone number off hand. 立即；一时之间

headers: at hand 近在手边；即将到来
by hand 手工地；用手工
in hand 在手头；在处理中；受控制
on hand 在场；现有的；可供使用的
off hand 即兴地，未经准备地
offhand 未经准备地；随口地；傲慢的
rows: Don't worry about the future; just focus on the task at hand. 别担心未来；只专注于眼下的任务。
The invitation cards were all written by hand to make them feel more personal. 请柬全是手工书写的，以显得更有亲切感。
We still have some money in hand for emergency expenses. 我们手头仍留有一些钱以备急用。
A team of medical experts was on hand to provide assistance during the race. 赛跑期间，有一组医学专家在场提供协助。
I can't think of any off hand. 我一下子什么也想不起来。
I can’t tell you the exact number offhand, but I’ll check the records for you. 我没法随口说出确切数字，但我会为你查阅记录。

parts.text: To be really happy and really safe, one ought to have at least two or three hobbies, and they must all be real. to be + adj. 做目的状语 It is no use starting late in life to say: ' I will take an interest in this or that. ' it is no use doing …是没有用的 take an interest in = be interested in … 对…产生兴趣;开始关注 Such an attempt only aggravates the strain of mental effort. strain stress / tension / pressure n.压力 A man may acquire great knowledge of topics unconnected with his daily work, and yet get hardly any benefit or relief. relief n.宽慰，减轻，缓解 It is no use doing what you like ; you have got to like what you do . Antimetabole 回环 / 倒复 Broadly speaking, human beings may be divided into three classes: those who are toiled to death , those who are worried to death , and those who are bored to death . broadly adv. generally 大体上；概括地说 状语主语无需与主语一致的情况(习语；宏观与旁观...) toil v. to work very hard for a long period of time 长期辛苦工作，苦干 Broadly speaking, leaders may be divided into two classes: those who are created by demands placed upon them , and those who are ‘self-created’ through hard work and achievements . Fortune’s favored children belong to the former, whereas the latter, I believe, are the majority. GRE写作范文（分类句型） It is no use offering the manual labourer, tired out with a hard week's sweat and effort, the chance of playing a game of football or baseball on Saturday afternoon. be tired out / exhausted 精疲力竭；筋疲力尽 offer sb. sth. / sth. to sb. 向某人提供某物/ 把某物提供给某人 It is no use inviting the politician or the professional or business man, who has been working or worrying about serious things for six days, to work or worry about trifling things at the weekend . working or worrying about 正在工作或担心（动名词形式） to work or worry about 去工作或担心（不定式形式）
He exercises every day to be healthy. 他每天锻炼是为了（保持）身体健康。
To be really happy and really safe in the digital age, understanding cybersecurity is crucial.要在数字时代真正快乐和真正安全，了解网络安全至关重要。
Check the flight status again to be sure of the departure time. 再次检查航班状态，以确保起飞时间无误。
We arrived at the theater early to be ready for the opening act. 我们早早到达剧院，以便为开场演出做好准备。
Companies must innovate to be competitive in the global market. 企业必须创新，以便在全球市场中保持竞争力。
To be brief, the project was a total success. 简单地说，这个项目非常成功。
It’s no use crying over spilt milk. 覆水难收
When planning for retirement, it is no use starting late in life to say you will save enough money.在规划退休时，在晚年开始说你会存够钱是没有用的。
Recently, many young people have started to take an interest in traditional crafts. 最近，许多年轻人开始对传统手工艺产生兴趣。
It is encouraging to see young people take an interest in local politics and community service.看到年轻人对地方政治和社区服务产生兴趣是令人鼓舞的。

headers: be interested in … 对…感兴趣（侧重状态）
lose interest in … 对…失去兴趣
rows: He has been interested in astronomy since he was a child. 他从小就对天文学感兴趣。
She gradually lost interest in the project after several failed attempts. 在几次失败的尝试后，她逐渐对那个项目失去了兴趣。

parts.text: The long hours of computer work put a severe strain on his eyes. 长时间的电脑工作给他的眼睛带来了严重的负担。
When you are already exhausted, such an attempt only aggravates the strain and leads to burnout.当你已经筋疲力尽时，这样的尝试只会加重负担，并导致倦怠。
Taking regular breaks is vital for reducing the strain of mental effort during long work sessions.定期休息对于减少长时间工作期间的精神努力负担至关重要。

headers: stress （精神）压力；强调
tension （局势的）紧张；张力
pressure （外界的）压力；压迫感
rows: Modern life can cause a lot of stress for many people. 现代生活会给许多人带来很大的精神压力。
There is growing tension between the two neighboring countries. 这两个邻国之间的紧张局势正在加剧。
He is under a lot of pressure to finish the project on time. 他承受着按时完成项目的巨大压力。

parts.text: The booklet contains information on pain relief during labour. 这本小册子介绍了减轻分娩疼痛的知识。
Relief workers are still searching through collapsed buildings. 救援人员仍在塌了的建筑物里搜寻。
A shortage of funds is preventing the UN from monitoring relief. 资金短缺使得联合国无法监督救济工作。
Despite the minor adjustments, the team still got hardly any benefit or relief from the excessive workload.尽管做了微小的调整，团队仍然几乎得不到任何益处或解脱于过重的工作量。

headers: find a temporary relief 寻求暂时的缓解
permanent relief 持久的缓解；永久的解脱
to my great relief 令我大感宽慰的是
give immediate relief from pain 立即止痛
rows: Taking a short walk may help you find a temporary relief from the stress of work. 短时间散步可能会帮你暂时缓解工作压力。
The doctor is looking for a way to provide permanent relief for her chronic back pain. 医生正在寻找一种能持久缓解她慢性腰痛的方法。
To my great relief, the test results showed that the tumor was benign. 令我大感宽慰的是，检查结果显示肿瘤是良性的。
This new medication is designed to give immediate relief from pain after surgery. 这种新药旨在术后立即缓解疼痛。

parts.text: Eat to live, not live to eat. — Socrates
Forty is the old age of youth, fifty is the youth of old age. — Victor Hugo
Where there is marriage without love, there will be love without marriage. — Benjamin Franklin
The reasonable man adapts himself to the world, the unreasonable man persists in trying to adapt the world to himself. Therefore, all progress depends on the unreasonable man. — G. B. Shaw

So let us begin anew —remembering on both sides that civility is not a sign of weakness, and sincerity is always subject to proof. Let us never negotiate out of fear, but let us never fear to negotiate. — John F. Kennedy
And so, my fellow Americans, ask not what your country can do for you; ask what you can do for your country. — John F. Kennedy
Broadly speaking, there are two main schools of thought on this issue. 总的来说，关于这个问题主要有两种流派。
Generally speaking, people are more likely to succeed if they stay consistent. 通常而言，如果人们能保持一致，就更容易成功。
Broadly speaking, the new legislation aims to improve both environmental and public health standards.广义上讲，这项新立法旨在改善环境和公共卫生标准。

headers: broadly defined 宽泛定义；广义上的
smile broadly 灿烂地微笑；由衷地微笑
agree broadly 基本同意；大致赞同
rows: The term "culture" is broadly defined to include traditions, languages, and social habits. “文化”一词被宽泛地定义为包括传统、语言和社交习惯。
She smiled broadly when she heard the news of her promotion. 当她听到晋升的消息时，灿烂地笑了起来。
The committee agrees broadly with the proposals outlined in the report. 委员会基本赞同报告中所列的提议。

parts.text: Strictly speaking, the whale isn’t a fish.
Judging from his face, he must be ill.
To make a long story short, he wanted money, and tried to get it without working.
But as they are about to return, an unprecedented storm descends on the area and blocks their way home.
To make things worse something unexpected happens.
Farm laborers have to toil in the fields all day.
He was toiled to death.
I have nothing to offer, but blood, toil, tears and sweat.
By the end of the marathon, the runners were completely tired out. 马拉松结束时，跑步者们都已精疲力竭。
After working in the fields all day, he was physically exhausted and fell asleep immediately. 在田里干了一整天活后，他体力耗尽，立刻睡着了。
Preparing for the final exams left the students mentally exhausted. 准备期末考试让学生们感到心力交瘁。
The company decided to offer him the job because of his impressive experience. 因为他出色的经验，公司决定向他提供这份工作。
She offered some coffee to the guests as soon as they arrived. 客人们一到，她就给他们端上了咖啡。
The habit of working or worrying about tasks late at night can lead to insomnia. 深夜工作或担心任务的习惯会导致失眠。
You need to find time to relax instead of continuing to work or worry about your career. 你需要找时间放松，而不是继续为事业工作或操心。
The executive needed to disconnect entirely, not work or worry about trifling things at the weekend.这位高管需要完全脱离工作，而不是在周末工作或担心琐碎的事情。

As for the unfortunate people who can command everything they want , who can gratify every caprice and lay their hands on almost every object of desire -- for them a new pleasure, a new excitement is only an additional satiation. command v. 掌管，掌握 gratify v. satisfy 使满意；使高兴；满足（愿望等） get / lay one’s hands on sth. obtain sth. 得到某物 get / lay one’s hands on sb. to catch sb. you are angry with 抓住惹你生气的人 In vain they rush frantically round from place to place, trying to escape from avenging boredom by mere clatter and motion. in vain without success in spite of your efforts 徒劳地/白费力气地 For them discipline in one form or another is the most hopeful path. discipline in 在…方面的(自律/学科)
command great wealth
command a large vocabulary
It gratified him to see his students succeed in their careers. 看到学生们在事业上取得成功让他感到很欣慰。
The new product was designed to satisfy the needs of professional photographers. 这款新产品旨在满足专业摄影师的需求。

headers: gratify one's curiosity 满足某人的好奇心
satisfy the requirements 符合要求；达到标准
rows: He peered through the window just to gratify his curiosity. 他透过窗户往里看，只是为了满足自己的好奇心。
Applicants must satisfy the requirements for the scholarship to be considered. 申请人必须符合奖学金的要求才能被予以考虑。

parts.text: I would read any book I could get / lay my hands on .
I’ve been trying to get my hands on a copy of that rare book for years. 多年来我一直试图弄到那本稀有书籍。
I know the contract is in this office somewhere, but I can't lay my hands on it right now. 我知道合同就在这个办公室的某个地方，但我现在找不着。
Just wait till I get / lay my hands on you!
Wait until I get my hands on him; he will have to explain where he went. 等我捉住他，他必须解释清楚去哪儿了。
He warned the bully never to lay his hands on his younger brother again. 他警告那个恶霸再也不准碰他弟弟一下。
Obviously all her complaints were in vain.
Police searched in vain for the missing boy.
They searched for the lost keys for hours, but their efforts were in vain.他们找了丢失的钥匙好几个小时，但他们的努力是徒劳的。

headers: to no avail 徒劳无功；毫无效果
work to no avail 白忙一场；工作没有成效
shout to no avail 大喊也无济于事
rows: He rebooted my systems several times, but to no avail. They tried everything to start the engine, but to no avail. 他们尝试了各种办法发动引擎，但都无济于事。
The rescue team worked for hours to no avail as the storm grew worse. 随着风暴加剧，救援队工作了几个小时也徒劳无功。
He shouted to no avail because the noise of the waterfall drowned out his voice. 他大声呼喊也无济于事，因为瀑布的轰鸣声淹没了他。

parts.text: Success in long-distance running requires great discipline in training and diet. 长跑的成功需要在训练和饮食方面的高度自律。
Successful artists understand that discipline in one form or another is essential for consistent creative output.成功的艺术家明白，某种形式的纪律对于持续的创造性产出至关重要。
The teacher can't keep discipline in her classroom. 这位教师无法维持她的课堂纪律。

headers: self-discipline in 在……方面的自我约束
a discipline in 某领域的一门学科
maintain discipline in 在……中维持纪律
rows: She shows remarkable self-discipline in her studies, never missing a deadline. 她在学习上表现出非凡的自律，从未错过任何截止日期。
Genetics is a relatively new discipline in the field of biology. 遗传学是生物学领域中一门相对较新的学科。
It is essential to maintain discipline in the classroom to ensure effective learning. 在课堂上维持纪律对于确保有效学习至关重要。
